name: visio-image-rebuilder
description: Rebuild or restyle editable Microsoft Visio diagrams from reference images and existing .vsdx files, for scientific-paper figures. Recreates references as native Visio shapes, text, connectors, and groups instead of embedding a flat picture; supports multi-panel figure reconstruction, layout/color/font restyling of existing .vsdx files, and .vsdx inspection to catch accidental whole-image embedding. Requires Windows + a licensed local Microsoft Visio install.
